description: Cycle 1: test suite from scratch (18 tests) + unlink() method. Covers add/link/recall/neighbors/decay/stats.
Cycle 2: merge_nodes() (data+edge rewire+self-loop cleanup) + shortest_path() (BFS). 8 new tests.
Cycle 3: tag_nodes() + search_by_tag() + add(tags=). Tags column in SQLite. 4 new tests.

export_json/import_json — full graph serialization. export_json() returns versioned dict of nodes+edges. import_json(data, merge=False) restores or merges. Preserves IDs, tags, data, weights. +5 tests (30→35).
batch ops: add_many+link_many+delete_many — bulk node/edge operations. +8 tests (45→53). Single-transaction batch add, batch link, batch delete with edge cleanup. Zero regressions.
find_by_kind+search_by_data+edges_of — kind filtering, data key/value lookup, edge inspection (+11 tests, 53→64)
touch+top_nodes+count_by_kind — access tracking, top-N ranking, kind stats (+8 tests, 64→72)
has_node+rename_tag+clear_tags — existence check, tag rename, tag clearing (+7 tests, 72→79)
reweight+is_linked+all_tags — weight delta, edge check, tag listing (+12 tests, 79→91)

subgraph(depth)+unlink_many — neighborhood extraction for agent context, batch edge removal. subgraph traverses up to N hops returning export-compatible dict. unlink_many batch-deletes edges. +8 tests (91→99).
prune(min_weight)+aggregate(kind,field,fn) — memory cleanup removes low-weight nodes+orphaned edges; aggregation supports sum/avg/min/max/count by kind. +11 tests (99→110). Zero regressions.
